# webui/vendor — vendored editor bundles for Project Studio's IDE mode (fetched once 2026-11-23, committed as plain files; the server serves them statically, no build step)
cm6/cm-bundle.js (959217 bytes): one self-contained ESM module (esbuild --minify, zero bare imports left) exporting a single named export `CM`: namespaces `state`/`view`/`commands`/`language`/`search`/`autocomplete` (each holds exactly that package's runtime exports), the language functions `cpp() javascript() python() rust() go() java() html() css() json() markdown() xml()`, and `legacy.shell`/`legacy.cmake` stream-parser modes (use as `new CM.language.StreamLanguage(CM.legacy.shell)`). autocomplete kept: the minified bundle is 959 KB, well under 3 MB.
Themes: `@codemirror/theme` does not exist on npm and this `@codemirror/view` build exports no `Theme`/`StyleController` — style with `CM.language.HighlightStyle(...)` / `CM.language.defaultHighlightStyle`. `CM.view.EditorView` needs a browser (`document is not defined` in bare node); everything else above loaded and ran in bare node.
Pinned npm versions (registry latest at fetch time): @codemirror/state 6.7.6, @codemirror/view 6.43.15, @codemirror/commands 6.11.1, @codemirror/language 6.13.1, @codemirror/search 6.7.2, @codemirror/autocomplete 6.20.4, @codemirror/legacy-modes 6.5.5, @codemirror/streamparser 6.0.0, @codemirror/lang-cpp 6.0.3, lang-javascript 6.2.5, lang-python 6.2.1, lang-rust 6.0.2, lang-go 6.0.1, lang-java 6.0.2, lang-html 6.4.12, lang-css 6.3.1, lang-json 6.0.2, lang-markdown 6.5.2, lang-xml 6.1.0; transitives @lezer/{common 1.5.6 cpp 1.1.6 css 1.3.9 go 1.0.1 highlight 1.2.5 html 1.3.13 java 1.2.0 javascript 1.5.6 json 1.0.3 lr 1.4.12 markdown 1.8.1 python 1.1.19 rust 1.0.3 xml 1.0.6}, @marijn/find-cluster-break 1.0.4, style-mod 4.1.5, crelt 1.0.7, w3c-keyname 2.2.8, js-cookie 3.0.8; tooling esbuild 0.28.2, node v24.21.0, pnpm 11.28.5 (npm is not on this machine).

beautify/beautify.js (103273 bytes): js-beautify 2.0.3 as ESM with named exports `js_beautify`, `css_beautify`, `html_beautify` (beaut-entry.mjs imports the package's CommonJS module and re-exports those three; js-beautify's CLI deps commander/ini/nopt/js-cookie are not reachable from that entry and none of their names survive in the bundle).

Verification: `node --check` exits 0 on both files as written and as `.mjs` copies; `node --input-type=module -e "await import('file:///…')"` loads both; in bare node `js_beautify`/`css_beautify`/`html_beautify`, `CM.state.EditorState.create({doc})`, and `new CM.language.StreamLanguage(CM.legacy.shell)` ran and returned results; `CM.view.EditorView` throws `ReferenceError: document is not defined`, so view construction/widgets are the only browser-only symbols (every namespace loaded without a DOM).
Note: `.gitignore` keeps `/vendor/` at the root ignored; `!webui/vendor/` lets these three committed files through, so a plain `git add webui/vendor` stages them.
